messages:
Asha: Short timeline: we need an internal RN + announce by 11:30 PT. This release pins a model variant and includes batching tweaks. Keep announce compact.

Kai: I'll handle the pin and early canary. Plan: pin to redwood-model-v2.4.0-stable in staging, 5% canary, 100% after green. Will post deploybot links.

Matt: Happy to assemble the TL;DR and the CS blurb. I can also add the rollback bullets.

Olivia: I'll tag translation owners and add UTC equivalents. ETA for review: 11:05 PT.

Riley: Ops covers the quiet window 12:00-13:00 PT. Rollback lane ready. Share thresholds and I'll monitor.

Asha: Rollback plan: immediate repin to v2.3.9 if we trigger rollback. Recovery steps must be in the RN.

Kai: Running staging pin now:
```
/deploy pin redwood-model-v2.4.0-stable --env=staging
```

deploybot: Command received: `/deploy pin redwood-model-v2.4.0-stable --env=staging` (requested by Kai). Job ID: 12421.

Kai: Starting smoke test:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-model-v2.4.0-stable","prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .status
```

Matt: Draft announce snippet: 
"Internal release: v2.4.0-stable — serving & batching improvements. Pinned in prod for predictable throughput. Quiet window 12:003:00 PT (19:000:00 UTC). Rollback: repin to v2.3.9 if thresholds met. CS snippet and changelog links attached"

Olivia: Suggest small wording changes: use "improved throughput consistency" and always include timezone labels.

Riley: Propose rollback thresholds: (A) 5xx >2% sustained over any 10m window OR (B) P50 latency +20% vs baseline over 10m. If either, run rollback checklist: 1) open bridge, 2) repin to v2.3.9, 3) scale canary down, 4) notify CS.

Asha: Those thresholds look good. Kai, ping Riley when canary hits 5%. Matt waits for Riley ok before posting internal announce.

Kai: Canary traffic is at 5% now. Staging job: https://staging.deploy.redwood.ai/jobs/12421.

deploybot: Job 12421 update: canary healthy, error rate 0.1% in last 5m.

Riley: Monitoring dashboard. No issue at 15m. Will keep probe for 30m.

Matt: I'll hold the announcement text. Once Riley gives the green, I'll post and pin for 24h, tag #customer-success and #docs.

Olivia: Translations: FR & DE owners alerted. I'll append i18n keys in the RN doc.

Kai: Canary stable at 30m. Queuing promote: 
```
/deploy promote redwood-model-v2.4.0-stable --env=prod
```

deploybot: Promote command accepted. Job 12422 scheduled.

Riley: :thumbsup: from ops. Keeping bridge open through quiet window.

Matt: Posting internal announce now. Includes TL;DR, rollback steps, quiet window times, changelog link, and CS snippet. Pinned and shared to teams.

Kai: Promotion completed. prod traffic now on v2.4.0-stable. Job 12422 finished with status: success.

deploybot: Job 12422 complete 8/0 errors reported in post-promote checks9.

Riley: Watching metrics for 30m. If thresholds hit, I'll initiate rollback.

Asha: Nice and tidy. Followups: 1) attach canary perf graphs to RN (Kai), 2) finalize public changelog wording (Olivia + Matt), 3) close thread if no incidents. Reopen if needed. :rocket:
